relationships.description: McLaren fielded the M2B car in the 1966 Monaco Grand Prix.
The M2B car was powered by Ford's Indianapolis 500 engine.
The M2B car was also powered by the Serenissima V8 engine.
McLaren fielded the M4B car in 1967.
The M4B car was powered by a 2.0-litre BRM V8 engine.
McLaren built the M5A car for the V12 engine.
